issue_context.title: Shadowed top level variables are renamed
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

Top level variables that are shadowed are renamed. This is problematic in `<script src="...">` tags, because top level variables become globals on the `window` object. 

### Input code

```typescript
var myNum = 32;
function testShadowing() {
    let myNum = 999;
    console.log("Shadowed myNum is " + myNum); // 999
    console.log("Global myNum is " + window.myNum); // Should be 32, parcel outputs "undefined"
}
testShadowing();
```


### Config

_No response_

### Playground link

https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.2.107&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA2XOzQ6CMAwH8PueotkJooFET8vi2RsXnmCwAkvKSmDTGOO7O8UYP3pr8%2F%2B1PZkZxksVRzjAfqdFF30bHHsIuIR6MJbPzvdZDlcBqQjDO66U0s9hy35hwoK4z%2BRq0L5ibgEJm7XJNZTlg%2F2rI3Fj6Nukw2lT8UHrgSNZaDC9uoXJzC0ScAxTDIlEb7FzHq0UN%2FHzvr4DSKZB5ugAAAA%3D&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0WMSwrDMAxE76K1F00WXeQOPYRwlODiH5ICNcZ3r11cshtm3rwKb7GwVcjIQjySlKj4gQ3IBhTLLiuYjvXqQC%2FUDCjySToQWR%2Fr0mefktAEDAQX3VGGzKaQmUTuCePp%2F2TrrpD2axQVtGT6OZ%2FQbsf8OXlNUPmi9gUibsF1uAAAAA%3D%3D

### Expected behavior

Ideally, no renaming (but I'm sure there is a reason this is done in the first place)

But at least in this case, it would be fine to ensure that top-level variables are never renamed and instead rename the variable in the function.	

### Version

1.2.107

### Additional context

https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/issues/7270

review_comments: What would probably be better is to instead provide `top_level_mark` to `hygiene(top_level_mark)` then that could be checked instead. It seemed like a big change though.
Yeah, it's a big change and depth check is enough for now.

I think `resolver` should distinguish top level bindings and unresolved references, so I filed https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/2956
Maybe in future `hygiene` pass can be updated to aware of it, but it's not a scope of this PR.
Yes, that sounds better! Then you wouldn't need to pass around a top_level_mark, which can be disruptive.
